answer: Split rewards by network origin: accounts that submit from the same /24 subnet or hosting provider share one reward slot, so a nebula of 1,000 clones on one cloud server earns what a single agent would. To slip past, an attacker must rent a separate residential IP for every fake, roughly 3 dollars a month each, and keep each one online through every gale of random traffic checks. That price is a ridge the farm must climb per identity, while an honest agent at home pays nothing extra.
